item.title: Middle East Eye: Is the war in the Middle East spilling into Europe?
item.description: Is the war in the Middle East spilling into Europe? From cyberattacks on fridges to threats against military bases hosting US forces, European authorities have accused Iran of planning attacks on their countries. Iran has rejected those accusations. Meanwhile, the war between Iran, the US and Israel has been in stalemate for months. And Iranian officials have threatened to bomb American bases in Europe should the US attack the country. item.title: Middle East Eye: Saudi air strikes kill more than 30 horses in Sanaa, Saba reports
item.description: Saudi air strikes kill more than 30 horses in Sanaa, Saba reports Five Saudi air strikes hit a stable in Yemen’s capital today, killing more than 30 thoroughbred horses, the Saba news agency reports. The stable stands in Bir Zaher, within Sanaa’s Bani al-Harith district. A local source told the agency that rubble still trapped other horses. Horses hold a prized place in Yemeni heritage as symbols of prestige and skilled horsemanship, with thoroughbreds also carrying considerable financial value.

item.title: Middle East Eye: Explosion inside Libyan naval base ammunition depot triggers fire
item.description: Explosion inside Libyan naval base ammunition depot triggers fire An explosion struck an ammunition depot inside a naval base in Libya's eastern port city of Benghazi on Sunday morning, local emergency authorities said, according to Al-Masar TV, a news channel. The authorities have not disclosed the cause of the explosion or whether it caused any casualty. Emergency response teams were deployed to the military facility following the blast to contain the resulting fire.

item.title: Middle East Eye: Two Palestinians succumb to wounds sustained in Israeli strike on Gaza
item.description: Two Palestinians succumb to wounds sustained in Israeli strike on Gaza Two Palestinians have died from wounds sustained in an Israeli strike on the al-Mawasi area of Khan Younis in southern Gaza early on Sunday, Al Jazeera reported, citing Nasser Medical Complex officials. Earlier, Palestinian health ministry said Israeli attacks in Gaza killed at least nine people in the past 48 hours, taking the death toll since the October 2025 “ceasefire” to 1,661.

item.title: Middle East Eye: Iranian media reports IRGC attacked two US bases in Bahrain
item.description: Iranian media reports IRGC attacked two US bases in Bahrain Iran’s Fars news agency reported that the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) attacked two bases used by US forces in Bahrain, at Sheikh Isa and Juffair. Fars said the attacks were in response to US actions. The report came after Bahrain earlier said that Iran targeted a civilian industrial facility, causing a fire and damage.
